name: CARV English
description: Welcome to CARV English! We are a dynamic community of students passionate about our field. Join us to explore, learn, and grow through our various activities and projects.

events.name: ACT-ivites
events.detail: 1. Omg, block them :)) : Learn how to move on stage for maximum visibility, audience connection, and interaction with co-actors. 2. Collisions : Fun group activity to help actors navigate space and avoid “accidental collisions” while acting in scenes. 3. Hold your breath! : Breathing techniques, diaphragm control, and diction exercises. 4. How to dispose a body (on stage) : Awareness exercises to help actors understand their body’s range and how to use it expressively

events.name: Writer’s Purgatory
events.detail: 1. Mad Libs Gone Wild: You get a half-written script. But it’s got blanks... and you fill them in. The twist? The wackier your words, the better the scene. 2. Ay, Pass the story man : One participant starts with a line, and each person adds to it, creating an unpredictable plot. 3. Writing for theatre – Quick session on pacing, character depth, and dialogue flow.

events.name: The Big Backstage Story
events.detail: 1. Stage Setting Challenge – A scenario is given and teams design the set, decide prop placement, and present their vision. Prop & Costume Planning – Brainstorm and sketch how props could be made. Origami Souvenir – Make a simple origami (butterfly/ heart with the paper given for scriptwriting) that participants can take home as a keepsake. CARV English is one of the premier acting clubs in RVCE, was founded in 2001 , and continues to have a glorious history of actors and plays since then. We have been winners at premier national fests conducted at NIT Trichy , NIT Surathkal and IIT- Madras, and at various local competitions in Bangalore such as Manipal and NIMHANS. We conduct two flagship events: Coliseum and Productions, where original plays go up on stage, open to the public. CARV English is not just an acting club, its a place where you truly find yourself as you navigate through 4 years of engineering, a place which you can call home away from home. Come, enjoy the joys of theatre at CARV English. Follow us on: Instagram and Youtube CARV ENGLISH ISE SEMINAR HALL

events.name: IEM - Improv,
events.detail: Expressions and Mime ( not the dept.) 1. Do you have mood swings too? : Actors practice different emotions (joy, fear, sadness, anger) using both facial expressions and vocal tone. 2. An improverisation (by Michael G Scott) : Random prompts given; participants must create short, fun unscripted performances. 3. It’s Mime time to shine– Perform silent scenes; audience guesses the exact scenario.

events.name: 1-Minute Ad Film Challenge
events.detail: “Form a team, get a random theme, and create a short film in just one minute! This fast-paced challenge is all about creativity, teamwork, and having fun while experimenting with filmmaking. No experience needed—just your ideas and energy!”

events.name: Through My Lens” Vlog Challenge
events.detail: Showcase your day through the lens of your camera! Capture moments, moods, and stories of today and turn them into a creative vlog. This is all about expressing your personality and storytelling style.

events.name: CiNEPHILE CIRCLE
events.detail: A fun discussion on how movies tell stories beyond dialogues—exploring scenes, narratives, and how emotions are built through visuals and characters, from cult classics to pop- culture favorites.
